title: Validate manual loading-list row quantities and products before shipping commitment
description: Close manual loading-list row integrity using the shared container draft validator. LoadingStockOutLinkRules validates only rows with explicit SourceStockOutDetailId; unlinked rows skip quantity/product verification. ContainerLoadingListController.Calculate simply sums Cartons/Weight/Volume and ordinary create/update can persist negative/overflow totals or nonexistent/disabled products. Validate every actually persisted row before number reservation/write, both manual and linked, then revalidate inside current submit/approval/loading conversion locks. Preserve all explicit outbound and demand ancestry, and loading-to-document generation authority. Validation does not imply inventory deduction or accounting posting. Use actual EF precision/scale and existing unit normalization; validate calculated line/header quantities, weights, volumes and monetary totals for representability/overflow before numbering/writes. Preserve supported empty draft headers; operational submit/approve requires valid nonempty lines. Keep supported repeated product rows and cumulative source quantities. Validate the rows actually persisted after existing server-owned child identity/deleted-flag normalization: client IsDeleted must never hide a bad row that is then reactivated. Keep historical snapshots readable and cancellation/reversal usable; no new validation gate on those historical undo paths. No schema/migration, currency/unit mixing, business permission change or implicit inventory/finance posting. Adapt every related original unit/SQL fixture only with genuine existing identities/grants/live masters, retain all business assertions. Explicit logs/TRX/results .ai/logs/<task> only; preserve full original failures. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Manual and linked loading-list create/update validates live products and positive representable quantities, nonnegative cartons/weight/volume and bounded totals before numbering or any persisted mutation. Preserve supported empty drafts/repeated rows, header-only edits, snapshots and explicit StockOutDetailId ancestry; do not bypass via child deleted flags.

Submit/approve and current downstream shipping/document commitment revalidate current master/numeric/source eligibility under existing deterministic locks and caller/customer menus. Preserve actual outbound remaining-capacity checks and reversal guard; rejected operations leave quantities/status/source links/numbers/documents unchanged and never auto-post inventory or finance.

Meaningful unit and isolated real SQL cases cover manual/linked flows, invalid/deleted/disabled products, negative/zero/unrepresentable values/overflow totals, live master invalidation, hidden-line flags and header-only preservation. Run related loading cancellation/trade generation/source regressions, safe Release/full units; keep original failures and accurate browser blockers.
implementation_evidence: LoadingStockOutLinkRules:524 skips every SourceStockOutDetailId null row, quantity check:532 only occurs for linked rows. ContainerLoadingListController.Calculate:925-930 directly sums Cartons/Weight/Volume; child identity normalizer subsequently forces IsDeleted=false. ERP-367/369/373/485 protects source/cancellation/form behavior, not every manual row numeric/master integrity.
